audit_metadata.engine: Playwright / Chromium (MS Edge) & Node.js Inspection Suite

findings.title: Production Domain (alphaanalyticssol.com) Points to Wix Hosting, Returning 404/429
findings.evidence: DNS lookup for alphaanalyticssol.com resolves to 185.230.63.107 (Wix/Pepyaka server). Direct HTTPS requests return 404 (Not Found) or 429 (Rate Limited).
findings.impact: The modern React/Vite application built in this repository is not yet published to the production domain. Search engines crawling the live domain currently hit a Wix 404 page.
findings.recommendation: Configure DNS records (A/CNAME) to point to the production host serving the Vite build output (e.g. Vercel, Cloudflare Pages, Netlify, AWS).

findings.title: Conflicting Telephone Numbers Between Footer and Legal Policies
findings.evidence: SiteFooter.tsx and ContactSection.tsx publish +91 93915 69629 (WhatsApp). Terms of Service (§17) and Privacy Policy (§12) publish +1 (224) 217-9863 (Illinois, USA).
findings.impact: Discrepancy prevents telephone from being included in Schema.org Organization structured data without risking NAP inconsistency penalties in search knowledge graphs.
findings.recommendation: Owner should confirm whether the Illinois US number or the international WhatsApp number is the primary corporate contact point.

findings.title: Litigation Support Page Title Exceeded Google SERP Truncation Threshold
findings.evidence: Original title was 'Litigation Support & Investigation | Litigation Services | Alpha Applied Analytics Solutions' (92 characters), which causes trailing truncation on search engine result pages.
findings.impact: Brand and secondary keywords were truncated in search snippets.
findings.recommendation: Shortened to 'Litigation Support & Investigation | Alpha Applied Analytics Solutions' (70 characters). Synchronized across seoData.ts and litigationsupport.html.

findings.title: Robots.txt Properly Permits All Search & AI Crawlers and Declares Sitemap
findings.evidence: HTTP GET /robots.txt returns 200 OK with User-agent: * and Allow: /, referencing Sitemap: https://alphaanalyticssol.com/sitemap.xml.
findings.impact: Search crawlers (Googlebot, Bingbot) and AI discovery bots (OAI-SearchBot, Claude-SearchBot, PerplexityBot) can discover and crawl the public pages without artificial blockers.

findings.title: XML Sitemap Contains Exactly 12 Canonical Public URLs
findings.evidence: HTTP GET /sitemap.xml returns 200 OK with valid XML. Contains 12 URLs matching page canonicals. Zero localhost/staging domains, zero anchor fragments.
findings.impact: Facilitates comprehensive indexation of all core service pillars, practice areas, and legal disclosures.
findings.recommendation: Keep sitemap.xml updated when new practices or public pages are added.

findings.title: Dual-Layer Static and Dynamic Metadata Synchronization
findings.evidence: Static HTML entry points serve pre-rendered title, meta description, Open Graph, Twitter cards, and JSON-LD. React useSEO hook updates document.title and canonical on client-side SPA navigation.
findings.impact: Guarantees immediate metadata capture by static crawlers (LinkedIn, Twitterbot, Googlebot) and seamless UI state for human visitors.
findings.recommendation: Maintain the useSEO synchronization hook across all current and future routes.

findings.title: Valid Schema.org WebSite, Organization, and BreadcrumbList JSON-LD
findings.evidence: Homepage embeds WebSite and Organization schemas with verified legal name and logo. All 11 internal routes embed valid BreadcrumbList schemas reflecting navigation hierarchy. 0 JSON syntax errors.
findings.impact: Provides machine-readable entity identity and site structure to search engines and answer engines.
findings.recommendation: Add telephone to Organization schema once owner resolves the contact number discrepancy.

findings.title: Optimized Image Loading Attributes and Alt Text Accessibility
findings.evidence: Above-the-fold Lady Justice hero image uses loading='eager' decoding='async' with descriptive alt text. Below-the-fold practice and audience cards use loading='lazy'. Decorative geometry uses alt='' role='presentation'.
findings.impact: Prevents Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) delays while eliminating below-fold bandwidth waste and avoiding screen-reader clutter.
findings.recommendation: Preserve eager/lazy dichotomy on future image additions.

findings.title: Practice Detail Pages Under 500-Word Coverage Floor
findings.evidence: Word counts on practice detail pages range between 287 and 381 words, below Claude SEO's 500-word topical coverage guideline.
findings.impact: While word count is not a direct ranking factor, search engines reward deep topical coverage and comprehensive dispute methodologies.
findings.recommendation: When approved by client, expand practice pages with methodology walkthroughs, deliverable formats, and engagement FAQs without changing existing visual card styling.

findings.title: Text Extractability and AI Crawler Permissibility Verified
findings.evidence: All critical practice definitions, Alpha Lens tools, and legal disclaimers are available in semantic DOM text (not trapped in bitmaps). Robots.txt does not block GPTBot, ClaudeBot, or PerplexityBot.
findings.impact: LLM answer engines (ChatGPT Search, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews) can crawl, extract, and accurately ground citations on Alpha's services.
findings.recommendation: An optional llms.txt summary file can be deployed if direct LLM scraping discovery is desired in the future.

findings.title: Google Search Console, GA4, and Paid Backlink APIs Unavailable
findings.evidence: Audit executed strictly within local repository constraints without external API credentials (GSC, Moz, DataForSEO) or unauthorized tracking tags.
findings.impact: Live search impressions, CTR, real-world CrUX field data, and historical backlink authority cannot be verified until production deployment and GSC authorization.
findings.recommendation: Perform Google Search Console URL inspection post-deployment once domain DNS is active.
